subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four stale assertions are repaired, should the token, CodeQL, Docker publishing, Blacksmith builder, and Codex action updates land together as one dependency group?
rationale: The action commits are valid and the Codex change preserves legacy sandbox behavior, but accepting grouped executable replacements with credential, scanning, publishing, builder, and agent access remains an owner-level security choice.

options.title: Repair and land together
options.body: Synchronize the guards, verify the exact final head, and merge the group with security-owner approval.

options.title: Split privileged families
options.body: Separate token, CodeQL, publishing, builder, and Codex action updates into smaller owner-reviewed pull requests.

recommendation.title: Repair and land together
recommendation.body: Synchronize the guards, verify the exact final head, and merge the group with security-owner approval.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly assigns the most security-sensitive changed workflows to this team.
